## What

The pure rules of the host target generations, in `velnor-cache-rules` (no I/O; inputs are plain values; the existing cache rules are untouched). Rules G1 to G12 are in `crates/velnor-cache-rules/RULES.md`.

- `GenKey` (job, root, `compat` of exactly 16 lowercase hex digits; dir `<job>.<root>-<compat>`), `Sha`.
